name: s390_pci_mmio_write
synopsis: int syscall(SYS_s390_pci_mmio_write, unsigned long mmio_addr, const void *user_buffer, size_t length);
int syscall(SYS_s390_pci_mmio_read, unsigned long mmio_addr, void *user_buffer, size_t length);
description: The s390_pci_mmio_write() system call writes a specified number of bytes from a user-space buffer to a PCI MMIO memory location. It must be used on Linux Systemz platforms instead of direct memory access, ensuring the address belongs to a valid PCI MMIO page and does not cross page boundaries.

parameters.name: mmio_addr
parameters.description: The PCI MMIO memory address to write to

parameters.name: user_buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the user-space buffer containing the data to write

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Number of bytes to write, must not exceed the system page size and must not cross a page boundary

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, errno is set

errors.description: The address in mmio_addr is invalid
user_buffer does not point to a valid location in the caller’s address space
